+
+Guidance for AI coding agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Aider, Goose, Continue, Cline) working in this repo.
+
+## Primary instructions
+
+The canonical project instructions live in **[CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md)**. Read that file first. It covers:
+
+- Prime directive (correctness > simplicity > performance > cleverness)
+- TDD, YAGNI, DRY discipline
+- Canonical paths (task analysis, routing, consensus, adapters, pipelines, security)
+- Zero `any` TypeScript policy
+- Anti-sprawl + canonical-path rules
+- Governance (voting thresholds, refactor gates, fitness audit)
+- Untrusted input handling
+
+Non-Claude agents should treat CLAUDE.md as authoritative repo context equivalent to what Codex/OpenCode call `AGENTS.md`.
+
+## Skills
+
+This repo ships skills at **`skills/<name>/SKILL.md`** following the Anthropic Agent Skills spec. Claude Code autoloads them natively. Other agents should consult the generated index below.
+
+**Discovery for non-Claude agents:**
+
+1. Read **[`skills/index.yaml`](./skills/index.yaml)** — compact list of `{name, description, triggers, path}` for all 17 skills.
+2. When a user request matches a skill's triggers, read the full `SKILL.md` at the listed path.
+3. Follow its workflow.
+
+**Freshness:** `skills/index.yaml` is regenerated via `npx tsx scripts/generate-skills-index.ts` and gated in CI. Never edit it by hand.
+
+## MCP server
+
+Nexus-agents exposes 30 MCP tools via stdio. From any MCP-aware agent:
+
+```
+npx -y nexus-agents --mode=server
+```
+
+Tool reference: [docs/ENTRYPOINTS.md](./docs/ENTRYPOINTS.md).

prs.customDescription: feat(cli): add branch diagnostics command

prs.customDescription: feat(orchestration): chunk tasks into execution waves

adjudication.rationale: Medium: planExecutionWaves([a,b], 2) returns a second empty wave because the loop uses <= tasks.length; downstream wave executors that require at least one task will fail on a reachable exact-multiple input.

adjudication.rationale: Medium: every successful or failed call leaves a nexus-research-* directory behind because the temporary worktree is not cleaned up in finally; repeated research runs grow disk usage indefinitely.

prs.customDescription: fix(mcp): centralize write permission checks

knownBugs.summary: Authorization bypass because any tool requiring write permission is allowed before checking the caller permissions

adjudication.rationale: High: a non-admin viewer can invoke a write-protected tool because requiredPermissions.includes("write") makes the early return true based on the operation being sensitive rather than on the user having that permission.

prs.customDescription: feat(pipeline): persist artifact receipt after publish

knownBugs.summary: Missing await on writeAuditReceipt causes publishArtifactReceipt to report success before the receipt write finishes and turns write failures into unhandled rejections

adjudication.rationale: High: callers receive a successful PublishResult even if writeAuditReceipt later rejects, so audit receipt persistence can silently fail on a reachable filesystem error path.

prs.customDescription: feat(telemetry): buffer recent routing outcomes for distillation
